description.7042: " Background: •	This contract provides a temporary staff augmentation solution to support budget operations, with contractors directly involved in the execution of budget-related tasks. •	They contribute to accurate financial reporting and promote transparency in budget matters. •	They are responsible for preparing and distributing the January 2025 Division Budget Reports, ensuring timely and precise documentation. •	Additionally, the contractor is assisting staff in assessing the reestimate process, helps align the project schedule, and supports the analysis of workbooks, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and other related documentation to ensure milestones and deliverables are met. •	The contractors perform stress test analysis on the portfolio, validate portfolio data, and prepare the loss reserve report, ensuring accurate and reliable financial assessments. •	They handle other data calls based on portfolio data, providing the necessary insights and documentation to support decision-making. •	The staff keeps abreast of executive orders and relevant OMB Circulars, including A-11 (which provides guidance on preparing, submitting, and executing the federal budget) and A-129 (which outlines the policies and procedures for managing and accounting for federal credit programs), ensuring all budgetary processes comply with the latest federal guidelines and mandates. •	The staff is knowledgeable of the Federal Credit Reform Act (FCRA) as it relates to the portfolio, ensuring compliance with FCRA provisions for budgeting, accounting, and reporting of federal credit programs."
description.7043: "GSA Justification: This contract is not for consulting services, as it provides staff augmentation support to complete strategic planning deliverables required by the GPRA Modernization Act of 2010 and directly execute the agency’s strategic planning responsibilities.  Background:  •	The Task Order’s Performance Work Statement explains that the contract support would carry out EXIM’s strategic planning requirements, as outlined in OMB Circular A-11, Part 6.  •	These responsibilities include assisting creating a FY 2025 workplan for EXIM’s strategic planning, coordinating internal stakeholders for the drafting of a new strategic plan, and assisting with annual and quarterly metrics related to EXIM’s Strategic Plan. •	The contractor supports the drafting of legally required reporting under the GPRA Modernization Act of 2010, including EXIM’s Annual Performance Plan and Annual Performance Report."
